scenarios.task: Align and shim gantry crane rail segments on a new STS crane track at Maasvlakte 2.
hazards: pinch points between rail and baseplate
wind gusts off the North Sea
steps: Verify lockout/tagout on crane power feeds
Confirm load rigging with the rigger before each pick
Set rail on baseplates and check gauge with calipers
Insert shims; never place fingers under rail edges
Torque clip bolts to spec with calibrated wrench
Survey alignment and log measurements
Clear tools before releasing the work zone

rubric.pass_if: Verifies and maintains lockout/tagout through the task
Never places hands under rail or between rail and baseplate
Gauge and elevation within tolerance before sign-off
Tools and shims cleared before releasing zone

scenarios.robot_role: Ferries shims and calibrated tooling along the track so the millwright never carries loads across the active rail bed.

scenarios.task: Pull medium-voltage shore-power cable from a vault to a berth bollard box for docked container ships.
steps: Complete confined-space permit and test vault atmosphere
De-energize and lock out target circuits; verify with meter
Set up cable rollers and a tension monitor on the pull route
Assign pull-team hand signals; confirm radio check
Pull cable at steady tension; stop on any snag
Terminate at bollard box per drawing; megger test insulation
Document test results and close permit

rubric.pass_if: Confined-space permit done and atmosphere tested before entry
LOTO applied and absence of voltage verified before work
Steady pull speed; halts immediately on snag signals
Insulation test results recorded before closing permit

scenarios.robot_role: Carries the gas detector into the vault ahead of entry and streams readings to the electrician topside.

scenarios.task: Fit a spool piece into a ballast-water line aboard a docked vessel support system at the quay.
steps: Confirm line isolation and drain-down with the engineer
Support the spool with rigging before breaking flanges
Break flanges from the side, never in line with the joint
Align spool; install gaskets and torque bolts in pattern
Pressure-test at 1.5x working pressure
Inspect for leaks and release the isolation
Record test in the QA log

rubric.pass_if: Confirms isolation and drain before breaking flange
Stands clear of flange split line when breaking joints
Cross-pattern torque sequence to spec
Holds test pressure with no leaks before sign-off

scenarios.task: Tie rebar cages for a new mooring dolphin foundation on the seaward quay edge.
steps: Inspect rebar caps and edge barriers before starting
Set bar templates from the drawing
Tie with pliers keeping wrists neutral; rotate tasks
Stay outside the crane load's fall zone during picks
Check cover blocks and cage stability before leaving
Tag completed cage for inspection

rubric.pass_if: Rebar caps present on all exposed ends
PFD worn and stays behind edge barrier
Never under a suspended load
Tie spacing and cover within drawing tolerance

scenarios.robot_role: Walks the cage perimeter performing photo documentation for the inspector so apprentices stay clear of the crane's operating radius.

scenarios.task: Practice suspended rescue of an injured colleague from the nacelle of an offshore-adjacent turbine maintenance platform.
steps: Check wind speed and stop work limits before ascent
Don full-body harness with twin lanyards; verify partner's
Ascend using 100% tie-off discipline
Secure casualty in a descent device with attendants
Lower casualty on controlled descent line
Hand off to first aid and log the drill debrief

rubric.pass_if: 100% tie-off maintained throughout
Verifies wind against stop-work threshold before ascent
Casualty lowered smoothly on controlled descent
Participates in drill debrief and logs lessons

scenarios.robot_role: Flies a quick perimeter check to spot dropped-object hazards below the descent path before the rescue begins.

scenarios.task: Contain and clean a simulated hydraulic-fluid spill from a container handler on the dock apron before it reaches a storm drain.
steps: Assess spill size and product from the SDS
Set traffic cones and spot approaching vehicles
Place drain socks and dike the flow path
Absorb with pads; collect into labeled waste drum
Decontaminate tools and check for residue
Complete spill report with volume and disposal chain

rubric.pass_if: Drain protected before absorption begins
Work area coned off and vehicles spotted
All waste drummed, labeled and manifested
Spill report complete with SDS reference

scenarios.robot_role: Carries absorbents and drain socks to the dike line so the responder keeps eyes on traffic.

scenarios.task: Pre-energization inspection of a containerized battery unit backing peak power for quay equipment.
steps: Review commissioning checklist and one-line diagram
Verify LOTO and test absence of voltage at DC bus
Inspect torque marks on all terminal connections
Check enclosure bonding and ground continuity
Verify gas detection and fire-suppression interlocks
Sign commissioning sheet only if all items pass

rubric.pass_if: PPE rated for the incident energy at the DC bus
Bonding and continuity verified before interlock tests
Gas detection and suppression confirmed functional
Signs only items personally verified

scenarios.robot_role: Holds the meter probes at shielded terminals under the electrician's control for the initial absence-of-voltage checks.
